newsitem.title: USA: Cost cuts send Bucyrus Int'l Q1 net higher.
newsitem.headline: Cost cuts send Bucyrus Int'l Q1 net higher.

text.p: Bucyrus International Inc said Thursday that reduced costs of products sold and lower taxes contributed to an increase in earnings in the first quarter.
The surface mining equipment maker posted net income of $915,000, or $0.09 per share, up from $298,000, or $0.03, in the same period last year.
Net sales in the quarter slipped to $59.9 million from $61.5 million in the first quarter of 1996.
The cost of product sold fell to $48.0 million from $49.7 million a year ago, Bucyrus said.
Bucyrus said the improved results were also tied to its parts marketing program and an increase in machine quoting activity.
Bucyrus shares closed off 1/4 Thursday at 9-1/4.
